subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Counts to 10; counts legs and groups of 2 and 3 on bugs

show.line: Bugs have legs! A beetle has six legs. Three on this side, three on that side.

rounds.prompt: Count the legs on the ladybird. How many?
rounds.praise: Six legs! All insects have six legs.

rounds.prompt: Count the butterflies on the flower.
A spider is not an insect. Count its legs.
rounds.praise: Eight legs! A spider has eight.
Yes! An ant has six legs.

rounds.prompt: Count the snails. Say the number.
Six legs or eight legs? Put each bug in its group.

hints: Touch each leg as you count.
Count one side, then the other side.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the beetle's legs.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One, two, three, four. Four legs!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I forgot the back legs. A beetle has six legs.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. Three on this side, three on that side. Six!

parent_line: Can count to 10 and count the legs on bugs.
